Content Developer I

The University of Arizona is hiring a Content Developer I for the Eller MarCom team. The role supports website maintenance and development, marketing technology, creative work, and communications to help execute the Eller College’s marketing and communications strategies.
Education
Non Profit
Higher Education
Universities
No H1B
Responsibilities
Serve as an additional point of contact for website updates and maintenance
Support the design and development of the Eller College of Management website to ensure consistent look and feel
Optimize site(s) for search engine performance and assist with the creation of website usage reports to provide reporting on key metrics
Interface and troubleshoot with the UITS and the central web team
Maintain a thorough understanding of University of Arizona branding and Eller College marketing and communications strategy
Develop and assist with webpage creation related to events, special programs, marketing campaigns, promotions, etc
Help with the creation and dissemination of internal and external communications
Review and respond to MarCom shared email accounts
Collaborate with the MarCom team to monitor the behavior of web and social media audiences and provide insights and recommendations to optimize the digital experience and increase engagement
Graphic design skills to assist in the development of marketing collateral, physical and multimedia formats, for internal and external audiences (Adobe Creative Suite)
Collaborate with Eller College constituents for web updates and new content creation
Conduct training sessions for new users on marketing systems for the Eller College
Stay current on web technologies as it pertains to Eller’s marketing efforts
Assist with the integration process of related marketing technologies
Additional duties as assigned

Ability to work collaboratively as a member of a professional team, fulfilling obligations to the other team members, being positive and supportive of others and complying with policies, procedures of the team and College
Strong written and verbal communication skills required
Demonstrated marketing technology, design, communications and project management skills
Must be detail oriented and organized with ability to multi-task
Bachelor's degree or equivalent advanced learning attained through experience required
Up to 1 year of relevant work experience may be required
Visa sponsorship is not available for this position
Preferred
Graphic design skills and portfolio
Experience with Salesforce, Drupal, Adobe Creative Suite, Marq, and Canva
Experience managing content in a project management system such as Asana
Demonstrate proven attention to detail with accuracy and consistency
Experience using GSuite and Adobe Creative Suite
